name: Pandur II
armament: Philippine Sabrah: Elbit 105 mm light-tank turret
Others: 30 mm RCWS or 12.7 mm RWS
protection: Steel hull with add-on armour. Game: immune to all small-calibre rounds; frontal arc resists 12.7/14.5 mm; 7.62x54R damages optics, tyres/tracks and exposed gear, 12.7/14.5 mm penetrates side and rear; all launchers penetrate.
visual_notes: Angular 8x8 with sloped glacis, two axle groups
PHL Sabrah wheeled version carries a large Elbit 105 mm turret, making it a wheeled light tank
variants: Pandur Evolution 6x6 (AUT, Pandur I lineage; 225 ordered 2024, 36 with Skyranger 30)
